name: Lapisent
title: Inscriptional display with lowercase
description: An inscriptional serif display face with a ceremonial rhythm and true lowercase. Suitable for cultural identities, editorial titles and carefully spaced display settings.
story: Trajan is the historical inspiration. The chosen A alphabet consists of original native Recraft vectors, retained through vector extraction and documented seam repairs rather than raster tracing. The original generation prompt used an anatomy brief without naming a source font. Authored native-vector companions, optical spacing and an explicit artifact layout step extend the design. Version 1.003 corrects mixed above/below contexts while retaining every existing 1.002 contour and advance.
independent_review: Current final package cleared in integration handoff
distribution_terms: Pending owner review. No redistribution license is assigned to these sample font assets. The repository compiler license is unchanged.
build_boundary: The final 354-scalar assembly includes an explicit fontTools artifact step after the compiler-valid ordinary source. A full final-assembly stock CLI preflight/release pass is not claimed. Producer source-stage checks and final-binary validation remain separate.
limitations: Display use from 32px; body text and smaller sizes are not certified.
Exact listed coverage and documented language/one- or two-mark samples only. Arbitrary accent stacks, every Latin orthography and every rendering engine are not certified.
Static Regular TTF/WOFF2 only; no CFF OTF, variable axes or additional styles.
Strict typed-hyphen golden pixels differ from the discretionary wrap; real native-font semantics pass.
Synthetic j+cedilla/ogonek forms are technical tests, not native-language convention claims.
